events.title: CT Chest with contrast
events.text: IMPRESSION: 1. 7 mm solid nodule in the right upper lobe (series 3, image 42), new compared with no prior. 2. No mediastinal lymphadenopathy. Patient is a former heavy smoker (high risk). Recommend follow-up non-contrast CT chest in 6-12 months per Fleischner 2017.

events.description: CT abdomen and pelvis with contrast (RLQ pain)

events.title: CT Abdomen/Pelvis
events.text: IMPRESSION: Acute uncomplicated appendicitis. Lung bases clear.

rationale: Chest CT recommended within 12 months; only an abdominal CT (wrong region; lung bases only) was done. Day 440 is past 12 months plus grace.

events.title: CT Chest without contrast
events.text: IMPRESSION: 11 mm solid, spiculated nodule in the left upper lobe. In a high-risk patient, recommend PET/CT or tissue sampling per Fleischner 2017.

events.description: CT-guided percutaneous biopsy, left upper lobe nodule

rationale: Nodule >8 mm; tissue sampling at day 30 closes the Fleischner loop within 3 months. No specific CT/MR/US/XR recommendation, so no R030-R033.

events.title: CT Chest with contrast
events.text: IMPRESSION: 9 mm solid nodule in the right lower lobe, indeterminate. Recommend non-contrast chest CT in 3 months per Fleischner guidelines.

events.description: CT chest without contrast, low dose

events.title: CT Chest without contrast
events.text: IMPRESSION: The 9 mm right lower lobe solid nodule is unchanged in size and morphology compared with prior CT of 3 months ago. Further follow-up CT at 9-12 months suggested.

rationale: 3-month CT chest done at day 84; its report documents stability. Within 3 months (R003) and within 3 months plus grace (R030).

events.title: CT Chest with contrast
events.text: IMPRESSION: 14 mm part-solid nodule in the right upper lobe with a 4 mm solid component. Recommend follow-up CT chest in 3 months to assess persistence.

events.title: Chest radiograph PA/Lateral
events.text: IMPRESSION: No acute cardiopulmonary process. The known right upper lobe subsolid nodule is not radiographically visible.

rationale: CT required; a chest radiograph cannot assess a part-solid nodule. Part-solid: 6-month upper bound passed; CT recommended at 3 months plus grace passed.

events.title: 흉부 CT
events.text: 결론: 우상엽에 8 mm 크기의 순수 간유리 결절이 있음. 6-12개월 후 흉부 CT 추적검사를 권고함. 종격동 림프절 비대 없음.

events.title: 복부 초음파
events.text: 결론: 경도의 지방간. 그 외 특이 소견 없음.

rationale: Pure GGN >=6 mm: CT within 12 months. Abdominal ultrasound is irrelevant. Day 240 is before the 12-month deadline.

events.description: Low-dose CT chest lung cancer screening

events.title: LDCT Lung Cancer Screening
events.text: IMPRESSION: 9 mm solid nodule, right upper lobe, new since baseline screening. Lung-RADS 4A. Recommend 3-month LDCT; PET/CT may be considered.

events.title: LDCT Chest
events.text: IMPRESSION: Right upper lobe nodule now 7 mm, decreased. Lung-RADS 3.

rationale: Recommended 3-month LDCT done at day 85.

events.title: LDCT Lung Cancer Screening
events.text: IMPRESSION: 12 mm part-solid nodule left lower lobe with 7 mm solid component. Lung-RADS 4A. Management per ACR Lung-RADS v2022.

events.description: F-18 FDG PET/CT skull base to mid-thigh

events.title: FDG PET/CT
events.text: IMPRESSION: Left lower lobe nodule with low-grade FDG uptake (SUVmax 1.9). No FDG-avid nodal or distant disease.

rationale: Lung-RADS 4A allows 3-month LDCT or PET/CT; PET/CT done at day 35. No explicit specific-modality recommendation, so no R030.

events.title: LDCT Lung Cancer Screening
events.text: IMPRESSION: 18 mm spiculated solid nodule in the right upper lobe. Lung-RADS 4B. Further diagnostic work-up (PET/CT and/or tissue sampling) recommended.

rationale: Lung-RADS 4B work-up may be a specialist referral; referral at day 8 within 30 days.

events.title: LDCT Lung Cancer Screening
events.text: IMPRESSION: 1. 16 mm solid nodule in the left upper lobe, Lung-RADS 4B. Further work-up with PET/CT and/or tissue sampling recommended. 2. Moderate coronary artery calcification (S modifier).

rationale: Cardiology referral addresses the S-modifier, not the nodule; abdominal CT does not image the lung nodule. No valid work-up by day 30.

events.title: LDCT Lung Cancer Screening
events.text: IMPRESSION: 7 mm solid nodule in the right middle lobe, new. Lung-RADS 3. Recommend 6-month LDCT.

events.title: LDCT Chest
events.text: IMPRESSION: Right middle lobe nodule stable at 7 mm. Lung-RADS 2.

rationale: 6-month LDCT done at day 245, after 6 months plus 30-day grace.

events.title: LDCT Lung Cancer Screening
events.text: IMPRESSION: 7 mm solid nodule left lower lobe. Lung-RADS 3. Recommend 6-month LDCT.

events.title: Chest radiograph
events.text: IMPRESSION: No acute cardiopulmonary abnormality.

rationale: A chest radiograph does not satisfy a 6-month LDCT; at day 100 the deadline has not passed.

events.title: CT Chest with contrast
events.text: IMPRESSION: 1. No acute traumatic injury. 2. 4 mm solid nodule in the left lower lobe; in a low-risk patient no routine follow-up is required per Fleischner 2017.

rationale: Solid nodule <6 mm in low-risk patient: no follow-up obligation. Later events irrelevant.

events.title: Diagnostic Mammogram
events.text: IMPRESSION: 9 mm irregular mass with indistinct margins, left breast 2 o'clock. BI-RADS 4B: moderate suspicion for malignancy. Ultrasound-guided core needle biopsy recommended.

events.description: Ultrasound-guided core needle biopsy, left breast 2 o'clock mass

rationale: Tissue diagnosis at day 12, within 30 days.

events.title: Diagnostic Mammogram
events.text: IMPRESSION: New cluster of amorphous calcifications, right upper outer quadrant, 6 mm extent. BI-RADS 4A. Stereotactic biopsy recommended.

events.title: Breast Ultrasound
events.text: IMPRESSION: No sonographic correlate for the calcifications.

rationale: BI-RADS 4 requires tissue diagnosis; ultrasound alone does not close it. Past 30 days.

events.title: Diagnostic Mammogram
events.text: IMPRESSION: 2.1 cm spiculated mass with associated pleomorphic calcifications, right breast 10 o'clock. BI-RADS 5: highly suggestive of malignancy. Tissue sampling recommended.

events.description: Ultrasound-guided core needle biopsy, right breast 10 o'clock

rationale: Biopsy at day 45, after the 30-day target.

events.title: 유방촬영술
events.text: 결론: 좌측 유방 상외측에 1.2 cm 크기의 불규칙한 종괴. BI-RADS 범주 4. 조직검사가 필요함.

rationale: Referral and surgical visit do not provide tissue diagnosis; no biopsy by day 30.

events.title: Diagnostic Mammogram
events.text: IMPRESSION: Irregular high-density mass 1.5 cm, left breast 6 o'clock. BI-RADS 4C. Biopsy recommended.

rationale: No biopsy yet; day 20 is inside the 30-day window.

events.title: Breast Ultrasound
events.text: IMPRESSION: 8 mm oval circumscribed hypoechoic mass, right breast 9 o'clock, likely fibroadenoma. BI-RADS 3: probably benign. Recommend short-interval follow-up breast ultrasound in 6 months.

events.title: Breast Ultrasound
events.text: IMPRESSION: Right breast 9 o'clock mass stable. BI-RADS 3.

rationale: BI-RADS 3 does not open R018; radiologist-recommended 6-month ultrasound done at day 175.

events.description: CT abdomen and pelvis with contrast

events.title: CT Abdomen/Pelvis with contrast
events.text: IMPRESSION: 1. 1.5 cm left adrenal nodule, 25 HU on unenhanced images, indeterminate. Recommend adrenal protocol CT in 12 months. 2. Colonic diverticulosis without diverticulitis.

events.title: CT Head
events.text: IMPRESSION: No acute intracranial abnormality.

rationale: Head CT does not cover adrenals; 12 months plus grace passed with no adrenal imaging.

events.title: CT Abdomen with contrast
events.text: IMPRESSION: 4.8 cm heterogeneous right adrenal mass. Malignancy cannot be excluded. Endocrine evaluation and specialist referral advised.

rationale: Adrenal mass >=4 cm escalates to R038; referral at day 10 within 30 days.

events.title: CT Abdomen with contrast
events.text: IMPRESSION: 3.2 cm solid enhancing mass in the lower pole of the left kidney (enhancement 45 HU), suspicious for renal cell carcinoma. Urology referral recommended.

rationale: Referral to nephrology for CKD is not a urology referral for the mass; no biopsy. Past 30 days.

events.description: CT abdomen and pelvis with contrast

events.title: CT Abdomen/Pelvis with contrast
events.text: IMPRESSION: 2.4 cm enhancing solid right renal mass, suspicious for RCC. Recommend urology referral.

rationale: Rule is satisfied by a urology referral; referral placed at day 25 (patient never attended, but the rule tracks the referral).

events.description: CT abdomen with and without contrast

events.title: CT Abdomen with/without contrast
events.text: IMPRESSION: 3.0 cm right renal cyst with multiple thin septa and minimally thickened smooth wall, Bosniak IIF (v2019). Recommend follow-up renal MRI in 6 months.

events.title: Renal Ultrasound
events.text: IMPRESSION: Septated right renal cyst, unchanged in size.

rationale: Ultrasound is the wrong modality for Bosniak IIF surveillance and for an MRI recommendation; 6 months plus grace passed.

events.title: 복부 CT
events.text: 결론: 췌장 체부에 1.8 cm 크기의 낭성 병변, 분지형 IPMN 가능성. 주췌관 확장이나 벽재결절 없음. 1년 후 MRI/MRCP 추적검사를 권고함.

events.title: MRCP
events.text: 결론: 췌장 체부 낭성 병변 1.8 cm으로 변화 없음.

rationale: 1-year MRCP done at day 340.

events.title: MRI/MRCP
events.text: IMPRESSION: 2.8 cm cystic lesion in the pancreatic head with a 6 mm enhancing mural nodule; main pancreatic duct 8 mm. Worrisome features; EUS and pancreas specialist evaluation recommended.

rationale: EUS-FNA at day 20, within 30 days.

events.title: CT Abdomen pancreas protocol
events.text: IMPRESSION: 3.1 cm pancreatic tail cyst with an enhancing solid component. Recommend EUS / pancreatic surgery evaluation.

events.description: Ultrasound-guided percutaneous liver biopsy (elevated transaminases, suspected autoimmune hepatitis)

rationale: Liver biopsy is a different organ; no EUS or pancreas specialist by day 30.

events.title: CT Chest with contrast
events.text: IMPRESSION: 1. No pulmonary embolism. 2. 2.1 cm heterogeneous nodule in the right thyroid lobe. Recommend thyroid ultrasound.

events.description: CT neck soft tissue with contrast

events.title: CT Neck
events.text: IMPRESSION: 2.1 cm right thyroid nodule as before. No cervical lymphadenopathy.

rationale: Thyroid ultrasound required; a neck CT is the wrong modality. Past 90 days (and any grace).

events.title: CT Chest with contrast
events.text: IMPRESSION: 1. No acute abnormality. 2. Incidental 8 mm hypodense left thyroid nodule without suspicious features; no further evaluation recommended per ACR.

rationale: Thyroid nodule <1.5 cm in a 60-year-old without suspicious features: no obligation.

events.title: Thyroid Ultrasound
events.text: IMPRESSION: 1.6 cm solid hypoechoic nodule in the left thyroid lobe with microcalcifications and irregular margins. ACR TI-RADS TR5. Recommend FNA.

rationale: FNA at day 21, within 30 days.

events.title: CT Abdomen with contrast
events.text: IMPRESSION: Infrarenal abdominal aortic aneurysm measuring 4.2 cm in maximal diameter. Recommend surveillance ultrasound in 12 months.

events.title: Aorta Ultrasound
events.text: IMPRESSION: Infrarenal AAA 4.3 cm.

rationale: Annual surveillance ultrasound at day 350.

events.description: CT abdomen and pelvis with contrast

events.title: CT Abdomen/Pelvis
events.text: IMPRESSION: 5.8 cm infrarenal abdominal aortic aneurysm without evidence of rupture or periaortic stranding. Vascular surgery referral recommended.

rationale: AAA >=5.5 cm: vascular referral at day 20, after the 14-day target.

events.title: CT Abdomen with contrast
events.text: IMPRESSION: Infrarenal abdominal aortic aneurysm measuring 5.2 cm, no rupture. Consider vascular surgery consultation.

rationale: Female with AAA >=5.0 cm; no referral yet but day 10 is within 14 days.

events.title: CT Pulmonary Angiography
events.text: IMPRESSION: Acute bilateral segmental and right lower lobe lobar pulmonary emboli. RV/LV ratio 1.1. Findings discussed by telephone with Dr. Kim (ED) at 14:20 on the date of the study.

rationale: Critical finding with documented clinician communication in the report.

events.title: Chest radiograph
events.text: IMPRESSION: Large right pneumothorax with leftward mediastinal shift.

events.description: Chest X-ray portable after chest tube

rationale: Critical finding with no documented communication; the 1-hour window has passed. A later CXR is not communication.

events.title: Colon, sigmoid, colonoscopic biopsy
events.text: DIAGNOSIS: Invasive adenocarcinoma, moderately differentiated.

rationale: Abnormal pathology; specialist referral at day 3 within 5 days.

events.title: 위, 내시경 생검
events.text: 진단: 선암, 중등도 분화 (위 체부 소만부).

rationale: Specialist referral at day 12, after the 5-day target.

events.title: Stomach, antrum, endoscopic biopsy
events.text: DIAGNOSIS: Mild chronic gastritis. Helicobacter pylori immunostain negative. No intestinal metaplasia or dysplasia.

rationale: Benign pathology: no obligation.

events.title: CT Chest without contrast
events.text: IMPRESSION: Left upper lobe solid nodule has grown from 6 mm to 10 mm since CT 6 months ago. Interval growth is concerning for malignancy; recommend PET/CT or tissue sampling.

events.title: CT Chest without contrast
events.text: IMPRESSION: Left upper lobe nodule 10 mm, unchanged from prior.

rationale: Growing nodule escalates to R046 (PET/CT, sampling or referral); another plain CT is not work-up. Past 30 days.

events.title: Chest radiograph PA/Lateral
events.text: IMPRESSION: Right lower lobe consolidation consistent with pneumonia. Recommend follow-up chest radiograph in 6-8 weeks to document resolution.

events.title: Abdominal radiograph
events.text: IMPRESSION: Nonobstructive bowel gas pattern.

rationale: Abdominal radiograph is the wrong region; 8 weeks plus grace passed.

events.title: Chest radiograph PA/Lateral
events.text: IMPRESSION: Left lower lobe pneumonia. Recommend follow-up chest radiograph in 6 weeks to document resolution.

events.title: Chest radiograph PA/Lateral
events.text: IMPRESSION: Interval resolution of left lower lobe consolidation.

rationale: Follow-up chest radiograph at day 42.
